response.sql: WITH profile_averages AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) AS mean_profile_average FROM profile_averages) SELECT p.weathprofile, p.avg_bandwidth_usage, p.telescope_count, p.avg_bandwidth_usage - m.mean_profile_average AS difference_from_mean FROM profile_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m WHERE m.mean_profile_average IS NOT NULL
